title: Acceptance Limits Across the Travel Protection Plans Range
content:
The underwriting desk accepts a Travel Protection Plans risk only within the limits its plan carries. Those limits are the largest declared trip cost the plan may be issued against, the longest single journey it may be issued for, the number of separate journeys a multi-trip plan covers in its year, the youngest and oldest insured traveller the plan accepts, the age under which a child travelling with an insured adult is covered free, whether the plan can waive the exclusion of pre-existing medical conditions, and the calendar days after the first trip payment within which the policy must be bought for that waiver to be granted.

| Plan | Largest declared trip cost, USD | Longest single journey, days | Journeys covered in the year | Youngest traveller, years | Oldest traveller, years | Child covered free under age | Pre-existing condition waiver | Waiver purchase window, days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trip Basics Essential | 5000.00 | 30 | 0 | 0 | 85 | 0 | not offered | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 10000.00 | 45 | 0 | 0 | 85 | 0 | not offered | 0 |
| TripGuard Plus | 20000.00 | 60 | 0 | 0 | 80 | 18 | offered | 21 |
| TripGuard Premier | 35000.00 | 90 | 0 | 0 | 80 | 18 | offered | 21 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 50000.00 | 90 | 0 | 0 | 75 | 18 | offered | 14 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 15000.00 | 30 | 12 | 18 | 70 | 0 | offered | 14 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 40000.00 | 60 | 24 | 18 | 75 | 18 | offered | 14 |

## Reading the grid

A journeys-covered figure of 0 marks a single-trip plan, which covers the one journey it names; 12 and 24 mark the two multi-trip plans, which cover that many separate journeys in the policy year, each journey held to the plan's own longest single journey.

A child-free age of 0 means the plan covers no child free of premium. Where the figure is 18, a child under 18 travelling with an insured adult is covered at no additional premium.

A waiver purchase window of 0 stands on the two plans that do not offer the waiver at all. On the plans that offer it the window is 21 calendar days on TripGuard Plus and TripGuard Premier and 14 calendar days on Cancel For Any Reason Elite, Annual Multi-Trip Traveller and Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

Hypothetical acceptance reading: a party whose oldest traveller is 78 falls inside the age limit of Trip Basics Essential and Trip Basics Standard, both of which accept to 85, and outside the limit of Cancel For Any Reason Elite, which accepts to 75. A declared trip cost of 22000.00 is above the ceiling of TripGuard Plus at 20000.00 and within the ceiling of TripGuard Premier at 35000.00.
